T0: the committer timestamp of the commit that adds docs/sources/OUTLIER_INTEGRITY_V21_PREREGISTRATION.md to branch claude/outlier-integrity-v2
eligibility: the archive exports/archive/dynasty_export_*.zip was ADDED to origin/main by the automated data refresh (commit subject 'chore: automated data refresh ...')
its add-commit committer timestamp is strictly after T0
its payload scrapeTimestamp is strictly after T0
completeness: tests.archive_fixtures._degraded_critical_sources(payload) is empty (the rule V2 used); an incomplete board is never scored, and its non-degraded sources may feed the history lane only

windows.H_BUFFER: eligible boards added after T0 and before WINDOW_START; history-lane input only, never scored
windows.WINDOW_START: 2026-10-21T00:00:00Z, or the first UTC midnight after T0 if T0 is later (every date below then shifts by the same whole number of days)
windows.H_ORIGIN: complete eligible boards added in [WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END); WINDOW_END = WINDOW_START + 28 days = 2026-11-18T00:00:00Z
windows.H_TARGET: complete eligible boards added in [WINDOW_END, WINDOW_END + 7 days) = [2026-11-18, 2026-11-25); M1 horizon targets only, never origins, never gate boards
windows.G1: the first complete H_ORIGIN board whose add-commit timestamp is at or after WINDOW_START + 14 days = 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z
windows.G2: the last complete H_ORIGIN board (add-commit timestamp before WINDOW_END)
windows.G1_PRIOR / G2_PRIOR: the complete eligible board immediately before G1 / G2

extension: if the minimum sample is not met at WINDOW_END, WINDOW_END moves forward one whole UTC day at a time (G2 and H_TARGET move with it, G1 does not) until it is met, at most 14 days (latest WINDOW_END 2026-12-02T00:00:00Z); still unmet -> the held-out evaluation is INSUFFICIENT and the verdict is MORE RESEARCH REQUIRED
identityPrerequisite: the wrong-player gate is evaluable only if G1 and G2 both carry the U2, U2b and U3 scraper evidence stamps and the VID vendor-id mapping was live in the producing refresh (preregistration section 3.7); otherwise the wrong-player gate is BLOCKED (dependency) and the verdict is BLOCKED
earliestReady: 2026-11-25T00:00:00Z (all H_ORIGIN and H_TARGET boards exist), if no extension is needed and T0 < 2026-10-21T00:00:00Z
seal: no V2.1 or incumbent build, no score, no descriptive scan and no gate injection may read an H_BUFFER, H_ORIGIN or H_TARGET board before the Stage 4 run commit, except the manifest builder reading add-commit, hashes, scrapeTimestamp and the completeness field; every board is then evaluated once, at one code SHA
